system.description:
A versatile warrior that values tactical flexibility over the study of a single weapon. They are often mercenaries; veterans that have tried many weapons over their careers and are capable of competently using any of them at their disposal.

The Armiger is a great class for newcomers due to their relatively simple and effective skills which can easily complement other classes.
complications: A fellow mercenary is at odds with you.
Problems from the aftermath of an old battle spark up again.
